units.name: Bridge Demolition
units.notes: A single bridge, anywhere on the table, has aleady been wired with a demolition charge. Before the start of the game write down which bridge has been wired. At teh start if any of his turns, the British player may detonate the bridge. Roll a dice. On a 2+ the bridge is destroyed. On a 1 teh demolition charge fails to go off.
